cases.description: The unchanged build script refuses each early fault before the step it protects, offline: builder, knobs, arguments, interpreter, plist minimum, build directory, identity, stale identity, architecture, build-document, contract and guide copies, and the make entry

meson.build's fixed policy assertions refuse every poisoned option by name before compiling, a removed assertion fails its control and is named by the rule, and the output-target assertion refuses an x86_64 host
The configured directory build.sh reads evaluates the tree: a substituted worker file, symlinked, relative and absolute include escapes and a copied checkout are each refused by name
Runner sources, test registry, shared outcome vocabularies and the CLI usage/README surface agree
Limits inventory, copied questions and guide agree; standalone, staging, stale-input and link controls pass
Contract version manifest and every generated copy agree; generator, stale-copy and build-refusal controls pass
Architecture manifest, dot files, SVG stamps and document regions agree; citation, stale-copy and refusal controls pass

Build manifest, dot file, SVG stamp and document regions agree with build.sh; grounding rules over the script, meson.build, the Makefile, the inventories and the baseline, their banner gate, parser refusals and mutation controls pass
Uniform generator ownership, citation and prose contracts with mutation controls
Markdown reader controls, vendored parser bytes and the parser import boundary
Build, test and release ancestry uses direct Python; wrapper shebangs agree and independent weakening controls reject shim and bare Python commands
